id: \bI go to this school too.
en: \bI go to this school too.
it: \bAnch'io frequento questa scuola.

id: \bEveryone acts like I don't exist. It's not fair!
en: \bEveryone acts like I don't exist. It's not fair!
it: \bTutti fanno finta che io non esista. Non è giusto!

id: \rLusamine: Good to see you again \PN.
en: \rLusamine: Good to see you again \PN.
it: \rSamina: Che piacere rivederti, \PN.

id: \bTurtonator
en: \bTurtonator
it: \bTurtonator

id: \rMisty: Surprise! Bet you weren't expecting to see me here. You can thank Lana for that.
en: \rMisty: Surprise! Bet you weren't expecting to see me here. You can thank Lana for that.
it: \rMisty: Sorpresa! Scommetto che non ti aspettavi di vedermi qui. Puoi ringraziare Suiren per questo.

id: \rThis may be a vacation for me, but don't think I can't beat you in a battle.
en: \rThis may be a vacation for me, but don't think I can't beat you in a battle.
it: \rSarò anche in vacanza, ma non pensare che non possa batterti in una lotta.

id: \rMisty: Ugh, I still can't win. Maybe Brock will have a better chance. Last I heard he said he was going to visit Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center.
en: \rMisty: Ugh, I still can't win. Maybe Brock will have a better chance. Last I heard he said he was going to visit Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center.
it: \rMisty: Uffa, non riesco ancora a vincere. Forse Brock avrà più fortuna. L'ultima volta che l'ho sentito diceva che sarebbe andato a trovare l'Infermiera Joy al Centro Pokémon.

id: \bSamson: Take your seat and we will begin.
en: \bSamson: Take your seat and we will begin.
it: \bSamson: Prendete posto e cominceremo.

id: \rSweet!
en: \rSweet!
it: \rForte!

id: \rSteenee
en: \rSteenee
it: \rSteenee

id: \rTsareena
en: \rTsareena
it: \rTsareena

id: \bSophocles: The Mossdeep Space Center was incredible. I'm glad Molayne was able to take me.
en: \bSophocles: The Mossdeep Space Center was incredible. I'm glad Molayne was able to take me.
it: \bChrys: Il Centro Spaziale di Verdeazzupoli era incredibile. Sono contento che Molayne abbia potuto portarmici.

id: \bBut you probably want a battle. I suppose we can.
en: \bBut you probably want a battle. I suppose we can.
it: \bMa tu probabilmente vuoi lottare. Va bene, si può fare.

id: \bSophocles: I'm going to stay here. I'll see you later.
en: \bSophocles: I'm going to stay here. I'll see you later.
it: \bChrys: Io resto qui. Ci vediamo dopo.

id: \bKukui: Take your seat, cousin, and we will start the lesson.
en: \bKukui: Take your seat, cousin, and we will start the lesson.
it: \bKukui: Prendi posto, cugino, e cominciamo la lezione.

id: \bKukui: Come look at the board if you're ever lost.
en: \bKukui: Come look at the board if you're ever lost.
it: \bKukui: Vieni a guardare la lavagna se ti senti perso.

id: \bKukui: Sit down and we will continue, cousin.
en: \bKukui: Sit down and we will continue, cousin.
it: \bKukui: Siediti e continuiamo, cugino.

id: \bKukui: I'll meet you at home.
en: \bKukui: I'll meet you at home.
it: \bKukui: Ci vediamo a casa.

id: \bKukui: Sit down and we will start, cousin.
en: \bKukui: Sit down and we will start, cousin.
it: \bKukui: Siediti e cominciamo, cugino.

id: \bKukui: It should be found in Melemele Meadow.
en: \bKukui: It should be found in Melemele Meadow.
it: \bKukui: Dovrebbe trovarsi al Prato Mele Mele.

id: \bKukui: Wasn't it nice of Lana to organize this?
en: \bKukui: Wasn't it nice of Lana to organize this?
it: \bKukui: Non è stato carino da parte di Suiren organizzare tutto questo?

id: \bKukui: Head for the boat.
en: \bKukui: Head for the boat.
it: \bKukui: Dirigiti alla barca.

id: \bKukui: I wish you luck. Come visit sometime.
en: \bKukui: I wish you luck. Come visit sometime.
it: \bKukui: Buona fortuna. Vieni a trovarci qualche volta.

id: \bKukui: Alola, cousin! How'd our champion doing?
en: \bKukui: Alola, cousin! How'd our champion doing?
it: \bKukui: Alola, cugino! Come se la passa il nostro campione?

id: \bWhy don't you take a seat for old times sake?
en: \bWhy don't you take a seat for old times sake?
it: \bPerché non ti siedi, come ai vecchi tempi?

id: \bKukui: I'm not here to battle you. I already know you can beat me.
en: \bKukui: I'm not here to battle you. I already know you can beat me.
it: \bKukui: Non sono qui per sfidarti. So già che puoi battermi.

id: \bKukui: If was great to see you again, \PN. We'll be rooting for you.
en: \bKukui: If was great to see you again, \PN. We'll be rooting for you.
it: \bKukui: È stato bellissimo rivederti, \PN. Faremo il tifo per te.

id: \bKukui: Take a seat, cousin.
en: \bKukui: Take a seat, cousin.
it: \bKukui: Prendi posto, cugino.

id: \rLana: My name is Lana. Nice to meet you \PN.
en: \rLana: My name is Lana. Nice to meet you \PN.
it: \rSuiren: Mi chiamo Suiren. Piacere di conoscerti, \PN.

id: \rLana: I guess you want to battle me.
en: \rLana: I guess you want to battle me.
it: \rSuiren: Immagino che tu voglia sfidarmi.

id: \rLana: I can't wait to go home and relax.
en: \rLana: I can't wait to go home and relax.
it: \rSuiren: Non vedo l'ora di tornare a casa e rilassarmi.

id: \rLana: I wonder what's in the egg.
en: \rLana: I wonder what's in the egg.
it: \rSuiren: Chissà cosa c'è nell'uovo.

id: \rLana: Akala Island sounds exciting.
en: \rLana: Akala Island sounds exciting.
it: \rSuiren: L'Isola di Akala sembra emozionante.

id: \rLana: I've never been to Kanto before.
en: \rLana: I've never been to Kanto before.
it: \rSuiren: Non sono mai stata a Kanto.

id: \rLana: Another trip?
en: \rLana: Another trip?
it: \rSuiren: Un'altra gita?

id: \rLana: It's going to be too cold.
en: \rLana: It's going to be too cold.
it: \rSuiren: Farà troppo freddo.

id: \rLana: Popplio and I have this.
en: \rLana: Popplio and I have this.
it: \rSuiren: Io e Popplio ce la caveremo.

id: \rLana: All the adults in town have lost their energy.
en: \rLana: All the adults in town have lost their energy.
it: \rSuiren: Tutti gli adulti della città hanno perso le energie.

id: \rLana: I invited Misty and Brock to visit Alola.
en: \rLana: I invited Misty and Brock to visit Alola.
it: \rSuiren: Ho invitato Misty e Brock a visitare Alola.

id: \rLana: I plan on meeting up with an old friend.
en: \rLana: I plan on meeting up with an old friend.
it: \rSuiren: Ho intenzione di rivedere una vecchia amica.

id: \rLana: This trip sounds fun.
en: \rLana: This trip sounds fun.
it: \rSuiren: Questa gita sembra divertente.

id: \rLana: A Pokémon League...
en: \rLana: A Pokémon League...
it: \rSuiren: Una Lega Pokémon...

id: \rLana: Good morning, \PN.
en: \rLana: Good morning, \PN.
it: \rSuiren: Buongiorno, \PN.

id: \rLana: Where will you go first?
en: \rLana: Where will you go first?
it: \rSuiren: Dove andrai per prima cosa?

id: \rLana: Alola. I like your new friend.
en: \rLana: Alola. I like your new friend.
it: \rSuiren: Alola. Mi piace il tuo nuovo amico.

id: \rLana: You picked me.
en: \rLana: You picked me.
it: \rSuiren: Hai scelto me.

id: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Carmo, located in Pewter City, is ready for battle.
en: Announcment. New opponent found for the World Coronation Series. Carmo, located in Pewter City, is ready for battle.
it: Annuncio. Trovato un nuovo avversario per le World Coronation Series. Carmo, a Plumbeopoli, è pronto a lottare.

id: \bKukui: Looks like you have another battle lined up. Good luck, \PN. We'll be rooting for you from home.
en: \bKukui: Looks like you have another battle lined up.  Good luck, \PN. We'll be rooting for you from home.
it: \bKukui: Sembra che tu abbia un'altra lotta in programma.  Buona fortuna, \PN. Faremo il tifo per te da casa.

id: \rLana: Come back again soon.
en: \rLana: Come back again soon.
it: \rSuiren: Torna presto a trovarci.

id: \rLana: It's great to see Lillie again.
en: \rLana: It's great to see Lillie again.
it: \rSuiren: È bello rivedere Lylia.

id: \bVulpix!
en: \bVulpix!
it: \bVulpix!

id: \bKiawe: I'm Kiawe. It's nice to meet a fellow battler like myself.
en: \bKiawe: I'm Kiawe. It's nice to meet a fellow battler like myself.
it: \bKiawe: Sono Kiawe. È un piacere conoscere un lottatore come me.

id: \bKiawe: I knew you would pick the strongest out of us.
en: \bKiawe: I knew you would pick the strongest out of us.
it: \bKiawe: Sapevo che avresti scelto il più forte di noi.

id: \bKiawe: What a day. I'm beat.
en: \bKiawe: What a day. I'm beat.
it: \bKiawe: Che giornata. Sono distrutto.

id: \bKiawe: I wish I could have the egg.
en: \bKiawe: I wish I could have the egg.
it: \bKiawe: Vorrei tanto avere io l'uovo.

id: \bKiawe: There should be all kinds of new Pokémon for you to find.
en: \bKiawe: There should be all kinds of new Pokémon for you to find.
it: \bKiawe: Dovrebbero esserci tantissimi Pokémon nuovi da scoprire.

id: \bKiawe: I can't imagine what we will see there.
en: \bKiawe: I can't imagine what we will see there.
it: \bKiawe: Non riesco a immaginare cosa vedremo lì.

id: \bKiawe: Visiting a science place isn't the most exciting.
en: \bKiawe: Visiting a science place isn't the most exciting.
it: \bKiawe: Visitare un posto scientifico non è il massimo dell'emozione.

id: \bKiawe: I won't get cold. I'm made of firey passion after all.
en: \bKiawe: I won't get cold. I'm made of firey passion after all.
it: \bKiawe: Non avrò freddo. Dopotutto sono fatto di passione ardente.

id: \bKiawe: My team and I will be able to handle this.
en: \bKiawe: My team and I will be able to handle this.
it: \bKiawe: La mia squadra e io sapremo cavarcela.

id: \bKiawe: My farm is in shambles. My parents are too tired to do anything!
en: \bKiawe: My farm is in shambles. My parents are too tired to do anything!
it: \bKiawe: La mia fattoria è un disastro. I miei genitori sono troppo stanchi per fare qualsiasi cosa!

id: \bKiawe: It's good to see them again.
en: \bKiawe: It's good to see them again.
it: \bKiawe: È bello rivederli.

id: \bKiawe: I'm going to battle Tapu Fini.
en: \bKiawe: I'm going to battle Tapu Fini.
it: \bKiawe: Sfiderò Tapu Fini.

id: \bKiawe: I can't wait to try out the gym.
en: \bKiawe: I can't wait to try out the gym.
it: \bKiawe: Non vedo l'ora di provare la palestra.

id: \bKiawe: Just you wait, \PN. I'm going to become the Champion.
en: \bKiawe: Just you wait, \PN. I'm going to become the Champion.
it: \bKiawe: Aspetta e vedrai, \PN. Diventerò il Campione.

id: \bKiawe: I'm fired up. This class will be exciting.
en: \bKiawe: I'm fired up. This class will be exciting.
it: \bKiawe: Sono carichissimo. Questa lezione sarà emozionante.

id: \bKiawe: That was a great battle.
en: \bKiawe: That was a great battle.
it: \bKiawe: È stata una gran bella lotta.

id: \bKiawe: I'm concerned about Goh. He doesn't like to battle. Who do you battle now?
en: \bKiawe: I'm concerned about Goh. He doesn't like to battle. Who do you battle now?
it: \bKiawe: Sono preoccupato per Goh. Non gli piace lottare. Contro chi vuoi lottare adesso?

id: \bKiawe: I'll get you into shape. Let's go!
en: \bKiawe: I'll get you into shape. Let's go!
it: \bKiawe: Ti rimetterò in forma io. Andiamo!

id: \bKiawe: Good luck in your next battle.
en: \bKiawe: Good luck in your next battle.
it: \bKiawe: Buona fortuna per la tua prossima lotta.

id: \bEevee
en: \bEevee
it: \bEevee

id: \bGladion: I'm ready to get back to training.
en: \bGladion: I'm ready to get back to training.
it: \bIridio: Sono pronto a tornare ad allenarmi.

id: Rotom Dex:... It's hiding in the plants on the right side of the school.
en: Rotom Dex:... It's hiding in the plants on the right side of the school.
it: Rotom Dex:... Si nasconde tra le piante sul lato destro della scuola.

id: \bKukui: Alola! For our first lesson with our new student we are going to explore the forest near the school.
en: \bKukui: Alola! For our first lesson with our new student we are going to explore the forest near the school.
it: \bKukui: Alola! Per la prima lezione con il nostro nuovo studente, esploreremo la foresta vicino alla scuola.

id: \bAlola has a bunch of new Pokémon for \PN to see. Come find me in the forest and we will head back whenever you're done.
en: \bAlola has a bunch of new Pokémon for \PN to see.  Come find me in the forest and we will head back whenever you're done.
it: \bAd Alola ci sono un sacco di Pokémon nuovi da far vedere a \PN.  Venite a cercarmi nella foresta e torneremo indietro quando avrete finito.

id: \bKukui: Let's have a battle now that everyone is here. Pick whoever you want.
en: \bKukui: Let's have a battle now that everyone is here. Pick whoever you want.
it: \bKukui: Ora che ci siamo tutti, facciamo una lotta. Scegli chi vuoi.

id: \bKukui: That was a great battle. Before we go, I see \PN has a Z-Ring on. Where did you get that?
en: \bKukui: That was a great battle. Before we go, I see \PN has a Z-Ring on. Where did you get that?
it: \bKukui: È stata una gran bella lotta. Prima di andare, vedo che \PN indossa un Cerchio Z. Dove l'hai preso?

id: \bWhat!? Tapu Koko! It's rare for the guardian deity to take an interest in someone.
en: \bWhat!? Tapu Koko! It's rare for the guardian deity to take an interest in someone.
it: \bCosa!? Tapu Koko! È raro che il nume custode si interessi a qualcuno.

id: \bAnyways, that Z-Ring will allow you to use Z- Moves. With a Z-Crystal, you can unleash powerful attacks during battle.
en: \bAnyways, that Z-Ring will allow you to use Z- Moves. With a Z-Crystal, you can unleash powerful attacks during battle.
it: \bComunque, quel Cerchio Z ti permetterà di usare le Mosse Z. Con un Cristallo Z, potrai scatenare attacchi potentissimi durante la lotta.

id: \bClearing a trial is a good way to earn one. That's it for today. Everyone can head home.
en: \bClearing a trial is a good way to earn one. That's it for today. Everyone can head home.
it: \bSuperare una prova è un buon modo per ottenerne uno. Per oggi è tutto. Potete tornare tutti a casa.

id: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started. We have two eggs in front of us. Who wants to raise one?
en: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started. We have two eggs in front of us. Who wants to raise one?
it: \bKukui: Ora che \PN è qui possiamo cominciare. Abbiamo davanti due uova. Chi vuole allevarne uno?

id: \rLillie: I do! I would love to get over my fear of Pokémon and maybe starting small will fix it.
en: \rLillie: I do! I would love to get over my fear of Pokémon and maybe starting small will fix it.
it: \rLylia: Io! Mi piacerebbe tanto superare la mia paura dei Pokémon, e forse cominciare da qualcosa di piccolo mi aiuterà.

id: \bSamson: Well if there are no objections then the egg is yours. I'll take the other one. I'm excited to see what it becomes.
en: \bSamson: Well if there are no objections then the egg is yours. I'll take the other one. I'm excited to see what it becomes.
it: \bSamson: Bene, se non ci sono obiezioni l'uovo è tuo. Io prenderò l'altro. Sono curioso di vedere cosa ne verrà fuori.

id: \bKukui: Glad we got that figured out. I also wanted to quickly explain to \PN what Alola forms are.
en: \bKukui: Glad we got that figured out. I also wanted to quickly explain to \PN what Alola forms are.
it: \bKukui: Sono contento che abbiamo risolto. Volevo anche spiegare velocemente a \PN cosa sono le forme di Alola.

id: \bIn Alola, some Pokémon look and behave different than they do elsewhere in the world. You may have seen some by now.
en: \bIn Alola, some Pokémon look and behave different than they do elsewhere in the world. You may have seen some by now.
it: \bAd Alola, alcuni Pokémon hanno un aspetto e un comportamento diversi rispetto al resto del mondo. Forse ne hai già visto qualcuno.

id: \bIn fact, even Pikachu evolves into something different: an Electric and Psychic type. Isn't it amazing!?
en: \bIn fact, even Pikachu evolves into something different: an Electric and Psychic type. Isn't it amazing!?
it: \bAnzi, persino Pikachu si evolve in qualcosa di diverso: un Pokémon di tipo Elettro e Psico. Non è incredibile!?

id: \bWell that's it for now. \PN, head over to Lillie's place and make sure the egg gets there safely.
en: \bWell that's it for now. \PN, head over to Lillie's place and make sure the egg gets there safely.
it: \bBene, per ora è tutto. \PN, vai a casa di Lylia e assicurati che l'uovo arrivi sano e salvo.

id: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started. We have a special trip planned today. But first, let me introduce our guest.
en: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started. We have a special trip planned today. But first, let me introduce our guest.
it: \bKukui: Ora che \PN è qui possiamo cominciare. Oggi abbiamo in programma una gita speciale. Ma prima lasciate che vi presenti la nostra ospite.

id: \bThis is Olivia. Say Alola everyone.
en: \bThis is Olivia. Say Alola everyone.
it: \bLei è Olivia. Dite tutti Alola.

id: \rOlivia: Nice to meet you all. I'm the Kahuna of Akala Island.
en: \rOlivia: Nice to meet you all. I'm the Kahuna of Akala Island.
it: \rOlivia: Piacere di conoscervi. Sono il Kahuna dell'Isola di Akala.

id: \bKukui: Speaking of Akala, we are all going to be going there as a field trip. I want you to explore the island.
en: \bKukui: Speaking of Akala, we are all going to be going there as a field trip. I want you to explore the island.
it: \bKukui: A proposito di Akala, ci andremo tutti in gita. Voglio che esploriate l'isola.

id: \b\PN, I've already told everyone else what they could do. There's a trial there for you to look into.
en: \b\PN, I've already told everyone else what they could do. There's a trial there for you to look into.
it: \b\PN, agli altri ho già detto cosa potrebbero fare. Lì c'è una prova a cui potresti dare un'occhiata.

id: \bWell that's it for now. Let's go to Akala Island!
en: \bWell that's it for now. Let's go to Akala Island!
it: \bBene, per ora è tutto. Andiamo sull'Isola di Akala!

id: Rotom Dex: There is a boat in Hau'oli City that will take us.
en: Rotom Dex: There is a boat in Hau'oli City that will take us.
it: Rotom Dex: C'è una barca a Hau'oli che ci porterà lì.

id: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started. Today we are going to learn about Mega Evolution and see some Kantonian forms.
en: \bKukui: Now that \PN is here we can get started.  Today we are going to learn about Mega Evolution and see some Kantonian forms.
it: \bKukui: Ora che \PN è qui possiamo cominciare.  Oggi impareremo cos'è la Megaevoluzione e vedremo alcune forme di Kanto.

id: \bAnd what better place to do that than Kanto? I hope everyone is ready because we are heading to Pallet Town!
en: \bAnd what better place to do that than Kanto? I hope everyone is ready because we are heading to Pallet Town!
it: \bE quale posto migliore per farlo se non Kanto? Spero siate tutti pronti, perché andiamo a Biancavilla!

id: \bProbably not the most exciting for you \PN, but everyone else has never been there. Let's meet at the blimp.
en: \bProbably not the most exciting for you \PN, but everyone else has never been there. Let's meet at the blimp.
it: \bForse per te non è il massimo dell'emozione, \PN, ma gli altri non ci sono mai stati. Ci vediamo al dirigibile.

id: \bKukui: For today we are going to visit the Aether Paradise. It's full of many wild Pokémon and Miss Lusamine is in charge of the place.
en: \bKukui: For today we are going to visit the Aether Paradise. It's full of many wild Pokémon and Miss Lusamine is in charge of the place.
it: \bKukui: Oggi visiteremo il Paradiso Aether. È pieno di Pokémon selvatici e a dirigerlo è la signora Samina.

id: \rLusamine: I'm always willing to do something nice for my little girl. This trip will be a blast.
en: \rLusamine: I'm always willing to do something nice for my little girl. This trip will be a blast.
it: \rSamina: Sono sempre disposta a fare qualcosa di carino per la mia bambina. Questa gita sarà uno spasso.

id: \bLet's head over to the ship in Hau'oli City.
en: \bLet's head over to the ship in Hau'oli City.
it: \bAndiamo alla nave a Hau'oli.

id: \bKukui: Today we are heading to Mount Lanakila. The snowy mountain on Ula'ula Island!
en: \bKukui: Today we are heading to Mount Lanakila.  The snowy mountain on Ula'ula Island!
it: \bKukui: Oggi andiamo al Monte Lanakila.  La montagna innevata dell'Isola di Ula Ula!

id: \bKukui: Lusamine and I had a chat and she has a special offer for all of you.
en: \bKukui: Lusamine and I had a chat and she has a special offer for all of you.
it: \bKukui: Samina e io abbiamo fatto due chiacchiere e lei ha un'offerta speciale per tutti voi.

id: \rLusamine: Due to your brave actions in rescuing me, I want to give you all the chance to become Ultra Guardians.
en: \rLusamine: Due to your brave actions in rescuing me, I want to give you all the chance to become Ultra Guardians.
it: \rSamina: Per il coraggio che avete dimostrato salvandomi, voglio darvi la possibilità di diventare Ultraguardiani.

id: \rBy doing this you will hunt down Ultra Beasts that pop up around Alola and help them find their way back home. I know you can all do it.
en: \rBy doing this you will hunt down Ultra Beasts that pop up around Alola and help them find their way back home. I know you can all do it.
it: \rIn questo ruolo darete la caccia alle Ultracreature che compaiono ad Alola e le aiuterete a ritrovare la strada di casa. So che ce la farete tutti.

id: \bKukui: With that said, the first one has already been spotted. It should be found in Melemele Meadow.
en: \bKukui: With that said, the first one has already been spotted. It should be found in Melemele Meadow.
it: \bKukui: Detto questo, la prima è già stata avvistata. Dovrebbe trovarsi al Prato Mele Mele.

id: \bBeast Balls might help getting them easier. Lusamine sent someone over who will sell you some.
en: \bBeast Balls might help getting them easier.  Lusamine sent someone over who will sell you some.
it: \bLe Beast Ball potrebbero aiutarvi a catturarle più facilmente.  Samina ha mandato qualcuno che ve ne venderà un po'.

id: \rMallow: Everyone else noticed that the adults are super tired, right?
en: \rMallow: Everyone else noticed that the adults are super tired, right?
it: \rIbis: Avete notato anche voi che gli adulti sono stanchissimi, vero?

id: \rLana: I was hoping it was just my parents that were like that.
en: \rLana: I was hoping it was just my parents that were like that.

id: \bKiawe: We need to do something to fix it.
en: \bKiawe: We need to do something to fix it.
it: \bKiawe: Dobbiamo fare qualcosa per rimediare.

id: \bSophocles: Sure, but what?
en: \bSophocles: Sure, but what?
it: \bChrys: Certo, ma cosa?

id: \rLillie: My mother called earlier today and told me what needs done. We need to go on an Ultra Guardians mission to the Altar of the Sunne.
en: \rLillie: My mother called earlier today and told me what needs done. We need to go on an Ultra Guardians mission to the Altar of the Sunne.

id: Rotom Dex: Let's all head to the boat!
en: Rotom Dex: Let's all head to the boat!

en: \bKukui: It's finally time that we head to Poni Island. All of you have your individual research projects, and I'll be leaving it up to you to complete them.

id: \bLana, you're to meet up with your friend. Kiawe, you're to train. Mallow, you're to learn how to make a new dish.
en: \bLana, you're to meet up with your friend. Kiawe, you're to train. Mallow, you're to learn how to make a new dish.
it: \bSuiren, tu incontrerai la tua amica. Kiawe, tu ti allenerai. Ibis, tu imparerai a preparare un nuovo piatto.

id: \bSophocles, you're to evolve your Charjabug. Lillie, you're to study the Pokémon living on the island. And finally \PN, you're to have your final Grand Trial.
en: \bSophocles, you're to evolve your Charjabug. Lillie, you're to study the Pokémon living on the island. And finally \PN, you're to have your final Grand Trial.
it: \bChrys, tu farai evolvere il tuo Charjabug. Lylia, tu studierai i Pokémon che vivono sull'isola. E infine \PN, tu affronterai la tua ultima Gran Prova.

id: \bNow that everyone is ready, head over to the boat. And good luck.
en: \bNow that everyone is ready, head over to the boat.  And good luck.
it: \bOra che siete tutti pronti, andate alla barca.  E buona fortuna.

id: \bKukui: Alola everyone. Today we're heading to Malie City, a city that takes heavy inspiration from the Johto region.
en: \bKukui: Alola everyone. Today we're heading to Malie City, a city that takes heavy inspiration from the Johto region.
it: \bKukui: Alola a tutti. Oggi andiamo a Malie, una città che prende molta ispirazione dalla regione di Johto.

id: \bFeel free to explore the unique culture. \PN, there is even a gym for you to participate in if you wish.
en: \bFeel free to explore the unique culture. \PN, there is even a gym for you to participate in if you wish.
it: \bSentitevi liberi di esplorare la sua cultura unica. \PN, c'è persino una palestra a cui partecipare, se ti va.

id: \bEveryone, let's take the boat to Tapu Village and head east from there.
en: \bEveryone, let's take the boat to Tapu Village and head east from there.
it: \bRagazzi, prendiamo la barca fino al Villaggio Tapu e da lì andiamo verso est.

id: \bKukui: Alola everyone. I'm very excited to announce that the first ever Alola League has been completed.
en: \bKukui: Alola everyone. I'm very excited to announce that the first ever Alola League has been completed.
it: \bKukui: Alola a tutti. Sono felicissimo di annunciare che la prima Lega di Alola della storia è stata completata.

id: \bI know all of you have been looking forward to it, so let's not waste any time. Head for the boat in Hau'oli City and let's head over.
en: \bI know all of you have been looking forward to it, so let's not waste any time. Head for the boat in Hau'oli City and let's head over.
it: \bSo che non vedevate l'ora, quindi non perdiamo tempo. Andate alla barca a Hau'oli e partiamo.

id: \bKukui: Alola everyone. As you're all aware, your vacation is starting and school will be on break.
en: \bKukui: Alola everyone. As you're all aware, your vacation is starting and school will be on break.
it: \bKukui: Alola a tutti. Come sapete, stanno per cominciare le vacanze e la scuola chiuderà per un po'.

id: \bWhat does everyone plan to do?
en: \bWhat does everyone plan to do?
it: \bCosa avete in programma di fare?

id: \bSophocles: I'm going to the Mossdeep Space Center.
en: \bSophocles: I'm going to the Mossdeep Space Center.
it: \bChrys: Io andrò al Centro Spaziale di Verdeazzupoli.

id: \rLana: My dad and I are going to look for a Manaphy.
en: \rLana: My dad and I are going to look for a Manaphy.
it: \rSuiren: Io e mio papà andremo a cercare un Manaphy.

id: \rMallow: I'm going to make my father's kitchen the best it can ever be.
en: \rMallow: I'm going to make my father's kitchen the best it can ever be.
it: \rIbis: Renderò la cucina di mio padre la migliore di sempre.

id: \rLillie: My family and I are going to look for my missing father.
en: \rLillie: My family and I are going to look for my missing father.

id: \bKiawe: I'm continuing my island challenge. One day I'll be an Island Kahuna.
en: \bKiawe: I'm continuing my island challenge. One day I'll be an Island Kahuna.

en: \bKukui: What about you, \PN? Going to travel the world some more? Sounds like a great plan to me.
it: \bKukui: E tu, \PN? Andrai a girare ancora il mondo? Mi sembra un ottimo piano.

id: \bKiawe: Not so fast. We never got to battle in the Manalo Conference. \PN, do me the honor.
en: \bKiawe: Not so fast. We never got to battle in the Manalo Conference. \PN, do me the honor.

en: \bKukui: That's it everyone. Enjoy-

en: Rotom Dex: Wait. I also want to talk about what I'm doing. If \PN is returning home, then I'm going to work with the Aether Foundation.

en: \PN, it's been wonderful being your Pokédex. Until next time.
it: \PN, è stato meraviglioso essere il tuo Pokédex. Alla prossima.

en: \bKukui: On that note, it's time you all went your own ways. Alola everyone.
it: \bKukui: Detto questo, è ora che ognuno di voi vada per la sua strada. Alola a tutti.

id: \bKukui: Everyone, let's give \PN and Goh a strong Alolan weclome! It's great to see our champion back.
en: \bKukui: Everyone, let's give \PN and Goh a strong Alolan weclome! It's great to see our champion back.
it: \bKukui: Ragazzi, diamo a \PN e a Goh un caloroso benvenuto alla maniera di Alola! È bello rivedere il nostro campione.

en: \bOf course, becoming a champion wasn't enough for him and he's now in the World Coronation Series.  No doubt he'll be the one to win it.
it: \bOvviamente diventare campione non gli bastava, e ora partecipa alle World Coronation Series.  Senza dubbio sarà lui a vincerle.

en: \bKiawe: Professor! I want to battle \PN. I want to help him get even stronger so he can win.
it: \bKiawe: Professore! Voglio lottare con \PN. Voglio aiutarlo a diventare ancora più forte, così potrà vincere.

id: \bKukui: How about it, \PN? Or would you rather battle someone else? Your choice.
en: \bKukui: How about it, \PN? Or would you rather battle someone else? Your choice.
it: \bKukui: Che ne dici, \PN? O preferisci lottare con qualcun altro? A te la scelta.

en: \bKukui: Everyone, let's give a strong Alola welcome to Lillie and Gladion's father, Mohn!
it: \bKukui: Ragazzi, diamo un caloroso benvenuto in stile Alola al padre di Lylia e Iridio, Mohn!

id: \bMohn: Thank you, everyone, for the hospitality. I know I've missed so much, but I promise I'm not going anywhere from now on.
en: \bMohn: Thank you, everyone, for the hospitality. I know I've missed so much, but I promise I'm not going anywhere from now on.
it: \bMohn: Grazie a tutti per l'ospitalità. So di essermi perso tantissimo, ma vi prometto che d'ora in poi non andrò più da nessuna parte.

en: \rLillie: Professor. Where's Kiawe?
it: \rLylia: Professore, dov'è Kiawe?

id: \bKukui: He left to do some last minute training upon learning \PN was coming back. There's a Battle Royal taking place soon. \PN, I assume you're interested.
en: \bKukui: He left to do some last minute training upon learning \PN was coming back. There's a Battle Royal taking place soon. \PN, I assume you're interested.
it: \bKukui: È andato ad allenarsi all'ultimo minuto appena ha saputo che \PN sarebbe tornato. Tra poco si terrà una Battle Royale. \PN, immagino che ti interessi.

en: \bMohn: I haven't seen one of those in years. Let's head over and watch.
it: \bMohn: Sono anni che non ne vedo una. Andiamo a guardarla.

en: \rLillie: I still can't believe you're a Champion.

id: \rLillie: Perhaps I'll see you during my travels.
en: \rLillie: Perhaps I'll see you during my travels.

en: \bGoh: H-Hey \PN. Your friends are nice.
